Cheskoban Cyber ​​is a continuation of the cheskoban series, a game that mixes a combination of chess with Sokoban. Now focused on the cyber-themed community and competition experience. On the cuber battlefield you will be able to compete looking for the best and fastest solutions to the puzzles, gain experience and build levels in creative mode and share with the whole community.


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40562884/812f43b0f261002bf70573e4f2a1a3725f8897d3.png[/img]
Controlling the main character you will be able to move your party's knights or bishops to the correct positions, or go through portals. Knights will capture enemy pieces with an "L" shaped move and bishops with diagonal move, based on chess. Once your knights or bishops are positioned correctly they will capture enemies all at once.

The Player which is an original piece created based on the King (is the character that will move the knights ).


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40562884/4c558af6286fdc7e189bdccc662ed115ce2a65c9.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40562884/c0cd0c80d016cbc70afcf0f274818fabab0b0a99.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Community and Experience System[/b]
[list]
[*] Gain experience with each level solved.
[*] Gain experience building and sharing levels with the community.
[*] The top 3 with the best solution for each level will gain experience.
[*] Progressively level up by playing.
[*] Top Rank Players.
[*] Top Build Level Players.
[*] Filter with the best levels rate by the community.
[*] Filters with easy levels and hard levels.
[/list]

[*][b]For the best experience:[/b]
[list]
[*] 30 original levels with increasing difficulty
[*] Creative mode
[*] Community Levels
[*] Playable with mouse and keyboard and ( Playable with mouse only ).
[*] Isometric and perspective camera modes.
[*] Good soundtrack
[/list]


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40562884/a75cb1daff64296db8361aaea678089ebae9cbe2.png[/img]
